checks.ref:
command:# Reports live under temporary-docs/gnomish/<task>/: the task branch's name without its
# gnomish/ prefix (the factory's own sanitized taskId), 'local' off a task branch.
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
case "$branch" in gnomish/*) task=${branch#gnomish/} ;; *) task=local ;; esac
dir=temporary-docs/gnomish/$task
change=$(sed -n 's/^Change:[[:space:]]*//p' $dir/change.md | head -1)
tasks="openspec/changes/$change/tasks.md"
open=$(grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*- \[ \]' "$tasks" || true)
if [ -n "$open" ]; then
  echo "$tasks still has unticked tasks:"
  echo "$open"
  echo "implement each of them, one subagent per task, and tick it once you have verified its work - not when the subagent says so. If a task cannot be done as written, do not tick it: escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE."
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f $dir/implement.md ]; then
  echo "no implementation record at $dir/implement.md - write it before finishing the round, see .gnomish/stages/implement/instructions.md"
  exit 1
fi

command:forbidden='^(\.claude/|\.gnomish/|openspec/specs/|openspec/changes/archive/)'
dirty=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | sed 's/^...//' | grep -E "$forbidden" || true)
committed=""
case "$(git branch --show-current)" in
  gnomish/*)
    if base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null); then
      committed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD | grep -E "$forbidden" || true)
    fi
    ;;
esac
touched=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$dirty" "$committed" | grep . | sort -u || true)
if [ -n "$touched" ]; then
  echo "the implementation touched paths no implementation may change:"
  echo "$touched"
  echo "undo your edits to these paths - .claude/ and .gnomish/ govern the factory's rounds, openspec/specs/ and the archive change only through archiving. If the change really requires editing one of them, escalate through \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE instead."
  exit 1
fi

command:log=$(mktemp)
if ! ./gradlew check --console=plain > "$log" 2>&1; then
  grep -E 'FAILED|What went wrong|error:|warning:.*\[|> Task .* FAILED|tests completed|mutation' "$log" | head -40
  echo "..."
  tail -40 "$log"
  echo "./gradlew check failed - fix the cause in the code or the tests, never by weakening a gate (no @DoNotMutate, exclusion or suppression the rules in .claude/rules/testing.md do not allow)"
  rm -f "$log"
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "$log"
